Eddy Plumes.name: Eddy Plumes
Eddy Plumes.description: The user sheds a handful of stiff primary feathers that ride small pockets of wind around a target within half a street's width. The swirling plumes deal slashing damage or pin the target's coat and sleeves to a wall or floor so they cannot move until they tear free. It covers half the range and feather count of a pure wing volley, and the thinned wings cannot lift the user until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.
